finish_summary:
Bulk discount logic mis‑classifies quantity ≥ 50 as 5% instead of 10%. Coupon parsing is case‑sensitive and strips whitespace, rejecting valid codes like "save25" or " SAVE50 ". Cart.items() returns only quantities; it should return (unit_price,quantity). Cart.remove_item() also returns just quantity instead of tuple.

These inconsistencies caused the test failures.
